title: Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.28080v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Violence in films and streaming media remains a concern for audience protection and creates substantial workload for manual content classification. Existing violence-detection methods often rely on limited modalities or short video clips, making it difficult to capture complementary evidence and localise violent events in long, untrimmed videos. In this study, we develop a framework for multimodal video understanding that classifies violence severity, predicts multiple violence types, and locates violent events in time. We combine temporally aligned visual and audio features extracted using pretrained encoders through attention-based adaptive fusion, followed by Transformer-based temporal modelling. Our framework supports three complementary tasks: video-level violence-severity classification, multi-label violence-type prediction, and temporal localisation of violent events. translated_title: 基于自适应音视频融合的电影多模态暴力理解与时间检索
translated_abstract: 影视和流媒体中的暴力内容仍然关系到观众保护问题，并为人工内容分类带来大量工作负担。现有的暴力检测方法往往依赖有限的模态或较短的短视频片段，难以在长且未经剪辑的视频中捕捉互补证据并对暴力事件进行时间定位。在本研究中，我们开发了一个多模态视频理解框架，能够对暴力严重程度进行分类、预测多种暴力类型，并在时间维度上定位暴力事件。我们通过基于注意力的自适应融合，将使用预训练编码器提取的时间对齐的视觉与音频特征相结合，随后进行基于Transformer的时序建模。该框架支持三个互补任务：视频级暴力严重程度分类、多标签暴力类型预测以及暴力事件的时间定位。我们在XD-Violence基准数据集上对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于注意力自适应音视频融合与Transformer时序建模的多模态框架，可同时完成电影中暴力严重程度分类、多标签暴力类型预测以及暴力事件的时间定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal framework with attention-based adaptive audio-visual fusion and Transformer temporal modeling, enabling joint violence severity classification, multi-label violence type prediction, and temporal localization of violent events in movies.
